guidance: We expect Asset Quality to stabilize around similar levels at the end of Q2FY27 and expect recovery from Q3FY27 onwards.

focus: We remain watchful of the operating environment, and our collection teams continue to focus on early intervention, recoveries a nd maintaining portfolio quality.
